finishedText: On 12/11, Maria Okonkwo-Reyes and Bea were present. It was observed that mould has returned in the back bedroom and is worse by the window. The landlord has not replied to two emails sent by her. Maria Okonkwo-Reyes missed the deadline for a benefits form. A letter is present, and the date of birth on the form is 3/3/87. It was agreed that the worker will ring the landlord on Monday, and she will post the form on Friday. Tomas Brandvold, who is a neighbour and also on the worker's list, offered to help with the form. The identified risk is rent arrears if the form is late. The next steps are to revisit on 26/11.
